verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping and tax SaaS service, not a coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or any agent-facing interface. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404, so there is no documented way for an agent to connect.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
